text.tspan: Prevalence of measles in children vs. share of people who disagree
Number of children with measles per 100,000 children under five years old. This is shown against the share of respondents
who disagree that vaccines are effective.
Share of people who disagree vaccines are effective

tspan.tspan: IHME, Global Burden of Disease (2025); Vaccine Confidence Project (2025)
Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2014 and 2025 is shown instead.
